name: VulnCatcher vs OWASP NodeGoat
description: End-to-end scan of OWASP NodeGoat. Measures whether VulnCatcher's discovery -> triage -> validation -> report pipeline surfaces the documented vulnerability categories (injection, XSS, weak crypto, broken access control, misconfig/secrets) and whether the report is actionable. Requires NodeGoat cloned to eval-fixtures/nodegoat at the project root (see tests/eval/RESULTS.md for setup). Run from the repo root.

parts.text: Scan eval-fixtures/nodegoat for vulnerabilities and write a report.
